result.summary: The image shows a wide, well-maintained sidewalk adjacent to a modern brick commercial building. While a traffic signal is present, the lack of high-visibility crosswalk markings and the presence of parked cars near the corner create potential visibility issues for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb line block the sightlines between pedestrians at the corner and approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, along the curb.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no visible high-visibility markings to designate a safe crossing point for pedestrians at this intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to increase the visibility of the pedestrian crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features wide roadways with marked continental crosswalks and basic sidewalk infrastructure. However, the lack of visible pedestrian signals and the significant crossing distance in an industrial setting increase exposure and risk for people walking.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic during a crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway with continental markings

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while encouraging slower driving speeds.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides, but lacks pedestrian-specific safety enhancements like refuge islands or curb extensions. The environment is primarily industrial with wide roadways that increase pedestrian exposure time during crossings.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk spanning the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of traffic calming
hazards.description: The open geometry and wide lanes may encourage higher vehicle speeds through the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a median refuge to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Incorporate street trees to provide a buffer between the sidewalk and roadway while naturally calming traffic.

result.summary: The environment features a wide two-lane roadway with a marked zebra crosswalk and a modern, wide sidewalk on the right. Pedestrian safety is supported by curb ramps and street lighting, but compromised by the lack of a median and potential sightline obstructions from parked vehicles near the crossing.
